java_model: CommandFactoryNote.executeInternal resolves the named note with quarkInContext and creates a note leaf in the current owner.
CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity.executeInternal creates generated GMN notes through the current quark context and adds a hidden note-to-target link.
Entity.leafs and Entity.isEmpty enumerate quark-backed heterogeneous children, so any surviving note makes its immediate owner nonempty.
GraphvizImageBuilder prints owner-local direct leaves before nested groups and prints unpackaged root leaves afterward.
CucaDiagram.applySingleStrategy forms Magma only from immediate standalone leaves and skips sets smaller than three.

DescriptionDiagram CommandLinkElement.getDummy calls quarkInContext and returns existing quark data before creating a dummy leaf. A named note used as either link endpoint therefore remains the same note entity.
rust_model: deployment_cluster_ids correctly admits owners of all laid-out notes, and fe78c98a threads that set through graph registration, traversal, frames, endpoint adjustment, rectangle recovery, and paint.

deployment_svek_leaf_order and deployment_svek_paint_order combine direct ordinary leaves and notes by quark_order; the fresh note-only, nested, sibling, generated-GMN, and Magma controls demonstrate broad generalization.

add_deployment_magma_constraints correctly excludes attached notes and ordinary connection endpoints in the represented AST, and its three/four-member owner-local squares match Java internally up to whole-diagram translation.

The parser does not maintain one heterogeneous identity lookup for explicit note relations. Its dotted special case mutates the note into target state and discards the source-line link event, while its general connection path checks only DeploymentNode and auto-creates an ordinary node for a known DeploymentNote ID.
The UID model then treats the dotted relation as a hidden attached-note link at note creation time, shifting later entity UIDs relative to Java's source-order link event.
overfit_and_constant_audit: No checker filename, mechanism name, distinctive label, golden path, or fixture-loading code occurs in the reviewed shipping paths.

The fe78c98a diff adds no parity-affecting coordinate constant. Its 0/1 tuple tags are deterministic sort tie-breakers and the Magma threshold of three is adjacent to the Java applySingleStrategy citation.
No evidence of per-fixture branches, coordinate surgery, or comparator manipulation was found. Rejection is for an incomplete underlying identity/event model, not overfitting.

findings.title: General explicit links duplicate known note identities as ordinary root nodes
findings.java_provenance: src/main/java/net/sourceforge/plantuml/descdiagram/command/CommandLinkElement.java:216-224,250-291 resolves existing quark data before dummy creation.
findings.rust_provenance: crates/rustuml-parser/src/parse/deployment.rs:862-910 resolves only DeploymentNode and auto-creates every unknown endpoint as DeploymentNodeKind::Node without owner membership.
findings.impact: The claimed heterogeneous immediate-child projection is incomplete before rendering begins. Rust can paint one named note twice under two identities/owners, including two root entities with the same data-qualified-name. This directly falsifies exact-once identity and inventory claims.

findings.title: The dotted-note shortcut erases the explicit link event and shifts identity/order
findings.java_provenance: DescriptionDiagramFactory registers CommandLinkElement before note-on-entity commands, and CommandLinkElement links the existing named note at the relation source line.
findings.rust_provenance: crates/rustuml-parser/src/parse/deployment.rs:703-723 mutates DeploymentNote.target and discards the connection; crates/rustuml-render/src/deployment.rs:6190-6219 consumes a hidden-link UID while processing the earlier note item.
findings.impact: WorkerV becomes ent0005 instead of Java ent0004, and the linked pair is placed on the opposite side of the unlinked sibling. The account's renderer-only model cannot preserve Java's source-order entity/link event stream.

findings.title: Several controls retain correct ownership inventories but differ in root or sub-threshold layout placement
findings.impact: These differences do not erase or reparent notes, and owner-local Magma 3/4 geometry matches. They remain useful executable evidence for later root-stream and non-Magma layout mechanisms.

verdict_reason: REJECTED. fe78c98a substantially repairs note-only clusters, owner-qualified names, generated GMN identity, and owner-local Magma, and no overfit was found. It does not establish the claimed single heterogeneous identity/event model for targetless named notes linked by explicit relations. Two directed-link inputs create duplicate ordinary nodes for existing notes, and the dotted-link path erases Java's source-line link event and shifts downstream identities. A valid failing counterexample rejects the mechanism under T14 rules 9 and 10; this review preserves three.
